Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: The genl contributors

Independent specialization of Genl/Curves/Covering.lean and
Genl/Curves/BelyiDescent.lean at Genl ea2846c877d1e16d8f0b911a5fed07f5ee69eaaf.
Only concrete algebraic points and Mathlib number-field heights occur below.
-/
import Definitions.Def_AbcTripod
import Mathlib.Data.Fin.VecNotation

set_option autoImplicit false

open NumberField
open scoped IntermediateField

namespace AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat

/-- The affine open of the actual Fermat curve U^N + V^N = W^N, W = 1,
with the two cusp coordinates nonzero. No arbitrary curve carrier is supplied. -/
def Pt (N : ℕ) : Type :=
  {p : Qbar × Qbar // p.1 ^ N + p.2 ^ N = 1 ∧ p.1 ≠ 0 ∧ p.2 ≠ 0}

noncomputable abbrev fieldOf {N : ℕ} (p : Pt N) : IntermediateField ℚ Qbar :=
  ℚ⟮p.1.1, p.1.2⟯

instance {N : ℕ} (p : Pt N) : FiniteDimensional ℚ (fieldOf p) :=
  IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_adjoin_pair (isIntegral p.1.1) (isIntegral p.1.2)

noncomputable def degree {N : ℕ} (p : Pt N) : ℕ := Module.finrank ℚ (fieldOf p)

noncomputable def u {N : ℕ} (p : Pt N) : fieldOf p :=
  ⟨p.1.1, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin ℚ _ (by simp)⟩

noncomputable def v {N : ℕ} (p : Pt N) : fieldOf p :=
  ⟨p.1.2, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin ℚ _ (by simp)⟩

/-- The morphism on the open parts is (u,v) ↦ u^N. -/
noncomputable def toTripod {N : ℕ} (p : Pt N) : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Pt :=
  ⟨p.1.1 ^ N, pow_ne_zero _ p.2.2.1, by
    intro h
    have hv : p.1.2 ^ N = 0 := by
      have := p.2.1
      rw [h] at this
      exact add_eq_left.mp this
    exact (pow_ne_zero _ p.2.2.2) hv⟩

/-- The actual extension used for both the normalized height comparison and
the Kummer discriminant bound. No independent field is supplied. -/
theorem fieldOf_toTripod_le {N : ℕ} (p : Pt N) :
    AbcAdaptation.Tripod.fieldOf (toTripod p).1 ≤ fieldOf p := by
  apply IntermediateField.adjoin_simple_le_iff.mpr
  change p.1.1 ^ N ∈ fieldOf p
  exact pow_mem (IntermediateField.subset_adjoin ℚ _ (by simp)) N

/-- Normalized discriminant of the full point field ℚ(u,v), not of ℚ(u^N). -/
noncomputable def logDiff {N : ℕ} (p : Pt N) : ℝ :=
  Real.log |(NumberField.discr (fieldOf p) : ℝ)| / degree p

/-- The normalized projective height of the actual point [u:v:1]. -/
noncomputable def projectiveHeight {N : ℕ} (p : Pt N) : ℝ :=
  Height.logHeight ![u p, v p, 1] / degree p

/-- The explicit representative associated with O_F(N-3).
Identifying this with a canonical-divisor height uses adjunction for the smooth
degree-N plane Fermat curve; that geometric step belongs to CanonicalEstimate. -/
noncomputable def canonicalHeight {N : ℕ} (p : Pt N) : ℝ :=
  ((N : ℝ) - 3) * projectiveHeight p

noncomputable def coefficient (N : ℕ) : ℝ := ((N : ℝ) - 3) / N

/-- Explicit field/height normalization bridge. This includes the height tower
normalization ℚ(u^N) ⊆ ℚ(u,v), the N-th power height formula, and the comparison
of [u:v:1] with [u:1] on U^N+V^N=1. It is not a definitional identity. -/
def HeightNormalization : Prop :=
  ∀ N : ℕ, 3 < N → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p : Pt N,
    |canonicalHeight p - coefficient N * htCan (toTripod p)| ≤ C

/-- Real Kummer-cover lift and arithmetic comparison. The existence includes
the extension ℚ(z) ⊆ ℚ(u,v), u^N=z, v^N=1-z, and the sharp N² degree bound.
The discriminant estimate is for the full extension, uniformly in z. -/
def LiftDifferent : Prop :=
  ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Pt,
    ∃ p : Pt N, toTripod p = z ∧
      degree p ≤ N ^ 2 * deg z.1 ∧
      logDiff p ≤ AbcAdaptation.Tripod.logDiff z + logCond z + C

/-- The divisor-free estimate for the actual proper Fermat curves of degree N>3.
This child owns the noncritical Belyi, local compactness, height/conductor,
and canonical-adjunction arguments; it remains an OPEN mathematical child.
The statement has no freely chosen height, curve, or Belyi theory parameter. -/
def CanonicalEstimate : Prop :=
  StatementII → ∀ N : ℕ, 3 < N → ∀ (d : ℕ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p : Pt N, degree p ≤ d →
      canonicalHeight p ≤ (1 + ε) * logDiff p + C

end AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat
nodes.source: Shinichi Mochizuki, Arithmetic Elliptic Curves in General Position, Theorem 2.1 (printed pp.11–13), Propositions 1.4, 1.6, 1.7; https://www.kurims.kyoto-u.ac.jp/~motizuki/Arithmetic%20Elliptic%20Curves%20in%20General%20Position.pdf . Reference parent refer/iut/Iut/Tripod/GeneralPosition.lean:269. Independent Fermat specialization of Genl pinned ea2846c877d1e16d8f0b911a5fed07f5ee69eaaf; this is a new adapted statement, not a renamed source theorem, and imports neither Iut, Genl, Heights nor Belyi. Source Genl/Curves/Covering.lean:97 (actual Kummer roots), :177 (Fermat covering), :425–448 (different), :460–473 (degree/lifts); Genl/Curves/BelyiDescent.lean:248–327; Genl/Curves/Theory.lean:60. The field is Q(u,v), the normalized projective height is that of [u:v:1], and the fixed canonical representative is (N-3) times that height. Its identification with an actual canonical-divisor height remains the explicit duty of the CanonicalEstimate child.

nodes.natural_language_statement:
> “Moreover, if $X$, $S$, and $T$ are defined over a number field $F$, then $\phi$ may be taken to be defined over $F$.”

— Shinichi Mochizuki, *Noncritical Belyi Maps*, Theorem 2.5, printed pp.5–6.

**English**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Ω`

The type $Ω$ is defined to be the algebraic closure of $ℚ(t)$, the field of rational functions in one indeterminate over the rational numbers. It is an abbreviation for this field, with no further conditions or parameters.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Model`

For every natural number $N$, including $0$, a model consists of an intermediate field $ℚ ⊆ K ⊆ Ω$, where $Ω$ is the algebraic closure of $ℚ(t)$, and elements $u,v ∈ K$, together with proofs that $u$ is transcendental over $ℚ$, that $u^N+v^N=1$, that the intermediate subfield $ℚ(u,v)$ of $K$ is all of $K$, that $K$ is finite dimensional over its subfield $ℚ(u)$, and that $[K:ℚ(u)]=N$. The parameter has no separately imposed positivity hypothesis; these fields and proofs cannot exist for $N=0$, since the required equation would be $1+1=1$ in a field of characteristic zero.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Model.trdeg_eq_one`

For every natural number $N$ and every intermediate field $ℚ ⊆ K ⊆ Ω$, where $Ω$ is the algebraic closure of $ℚ(t)$, equipped with elements $u,v ∈ K$ such that $u$ is transcendental over $ℚ$, $u^N+v^N=1$, $ℚ(u,v)=K$, $K$ is finite dimensional over $ℚ(u)$, and $[K:ℚ(u)]=N$, the transcendence degree of $K$ over $ℚ$ is exactly $1$. This quantification also includes $N=0$, for which no such model exists.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place`

For an arbitrary field $K$, the type of places is defined as the set of valuation subrings $O$ of $K$ that are proper, $O ≠ K$, and contain the rational cast of every $q ∈ ℚ$. Here a valuation subring is a subring such that for every $a ∈ K$, either $a ∈ O$ or $a^{-1} ∈ O$. There is no characteristic-zero assumption in this definition: in arbitrary characteristic, the containment condition uses the rational cast into $K$ as given, rather than requiring an embedding of $ℚ$. Neither discreteness nor finite dimension of the residue field is required.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.ResidueField`

For a field $K$ and a place $P$, meaning a proper valuation subring $O ⊊ K$ that contains the rational cast of every rational number, the residue field of $P$ is defined as the residue field of the local ring $O$, namely $κ(P)=O/𝔪_O$, where $𝔪_O$ is its unique maximal ideal. No finite-dimensionality hypothesis on this quotient is imposed.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.residue`

For a field $K$ and a place $P$ given by a proper valuation subring $O ⊊ K$ containing all rational casts, this definition gives the unital ring homomorphism $O → κ(P)=O/𝔪_O$ that sends an element of $O$ to its residue class modulo the unique maximal ideal $𝔪_O$. Its domain is the valuation subring $O$, rather than all of $K$.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.ratHom`

For every field $K$ of characteristic zero and every place $P$, represented by a proper valuation subring $O ⊊ K$ containing the cast of every rational number, this definition gives the unital ring homomorphism $ℚ → O$ obtained by restricting the codomain of the usual rational embedding $ℚ → K$ to $O$. It sends each rational number $q$ to its image in $K$, regarded as an element of $O$ using the containment condition on $P$.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.degree`

For a field $K$ of characteristic zero and a place $P$ given by a proper valuation subring $O ⊊ K$ containing every rational number, the degree of $P$ is defined as the natural-number-valued finite rank of the residue field $κ(P)=O/𝔪_O$ as a vector space over $ℚ$, with the rational scalar structure induced by the residue map. If that vector space is finite dimensional, the value is its dimension $[κ(P):ℚ]$; if it is infinite dimensional, this finite-rank convention gives $0$. No finite-dimensionality assumption is made.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.QbarPoint`

For every field $K$ of characteristic zero, a point of this type consists of a place $P$, namely a proper valuation subring $O ⊊ K$ containing the rational numbers, together with a unital ring homomorphism $σ:κ(P) → ℚ̄$, where $κ(P)=O/𝔪_O$ is the residue field and $ℚ̄$ is the algebraic closure of $ℚ$. The homomorphism, and thus the choice of residue-field embedding into $ℚ̄$, is part of the data. No finite-dimensionality hypothesis on the residue field is included.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.QbarPoint.eval`

For any field $K$ of characteristic zero, any point $x$ consisting of a proper valuation subring $O ⊊ K$ containing $ℚ$ and a unital ring homomorphism $σ:O/𝔪_O → ℚ̄$, any element $f ∈ K$, and any proof that $f ∈ O$, evaluation is defined as $σ(f+𝔪_O) ∈ ℚ̄$, where $ℚ̄$ is the algebraic closure of $ℚ$. Thus this definition takes the residue class of $f$ in the residue field and then applies the chosen homomorphism; it requires membership in $O$ as an argument.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.QbarPoint.fieldOf`

For a field $K$ of characteristic zero and a point $x$ consisting of a proper valuation subring $O ⊊ K$ containing $ℚ$ together with a unital ring homomorphism $σ:κ → ℚ̄$, where $κ=O/𝔪_O$ and $ℚ̄$ is the algebraic closure of $ℚ$, the field associated to $x$ is defined as the intermediate field $σ(κ)$ between $ℚ$ and $ℚ̄$. This is the image of the entire residue field under $σ$, viewed as a rational algebra homomorphism; equivalently its elements are exactly the $σ(a)$ with $a ∈ κ$. No finite-dimensionality assertion is part of this definition.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.QbarPoint.degree`

For a field $K$ of characteristic zero and a point $x$ consisting of a proper valuation subring $O ⊊ K$ containing $ℚ$ and a unital ring homomorphism $σ:O/𝔪_O → ℚ̄$, with $ℚ̄$ the algebraic closure of $ℚ$, the degree of $x$ is defined as the natural-number-valued finite rank over $ℚ$ of the intermediate field $σ(O/𝔪_O) ⊆ ℚ̄$. When this image field is finite dimensional over $ℚ$, the value is its extension degree; when it is infinite dimensional, the finite-rank convention gives $0$. Finite dimensionality is not assumed.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.QbarPoint.eval_mem_fieldOf`

For every field $K$ of characteristic zero, every point $x$ consisting of a proper valuation subring $O ⊊ K$ containing $ℚ$ and a unital ring homomorphism $σ:κ → ℚ̄$, where $κ=O/𝔪_O$ and $ℚ̄$ is the algebraic closure of $ℚ$, every element $f ∈ K$, and every proof that $f ∈ O$, the evaluated value $σ(f+𝔪_O)$ belongs to the intermediate field $σ(κ) ⊆ ℚ̄$. Here the evaluation is the image under $σ$ of the residue class of $f$, and the field is the image of the entire residue field; no nonzero condition on $f$ or finite-dimensionality condition on the field is required.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.PlacesDiscrete`

For any natural number $N$ and model $M$, this predicate says that every proper valuation subring $O$ of $M.K$ that contains the image of every rational number is a discrete valuation ring. Here $M.K$ is an intermediate field between $ℚ$ and an algebraic closure of $ℚ(t)$, equipped with elements $u,v$ such that $u$ is transcendental over $ℚ$, $u^N+v^N=1$, $ℚ(u,v)=M.K$, and $M.K$ is finite-dimensional of dimension $N$ over $ℚ(u)$. A place is exactly such a proper valuation subring; neither finite residue-field degree nor a chosen embedding of its residue field is part of this predicate. The parameter $N$ has no separately stated positivity hypothesis.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ResiduesFinite`

For any natural number $N$ and model $M$, this predicate says that, for every proper valuation subring $O$ of $M.K$ containing all rational numbers, the residue field $κ(O)$ is finite-dimensional over $ℚ$. Here $M.K$ is an intermediate field of an algebraic closure of $ℚ(t)$ over $ℚ$, with elements $u,v$ satisfying transcendence of $u$ over $ℚ$, $u^N+v^N=1$, generation $ℚ(u,v)=M.K$, and finite extension degree $[M.K:ℚ(u)]=N$. The rational structure on $κ(O)$ is induced by reduction of the rational elements in $O$. The predicate imposes no single common bound on these dimensions and does not itself require $O$ to be a discrete valuation ring; no separate positivity assumption on $N$ is stated.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ord`

Given a natural number $N$, a model $M$, a proof that every proper valuation subring of $M.K$ containing $ℚ$ is a discrete valuation ring, such a place $P$, and any $f∈M.K$, this integer-valued definition returns the negative of the multiplicative-integer logarithm of the value of $f$ under the valuation attached to the maximal ideal of $P$: $o_P(f)=-\operatorname{log}(v_{\mathfrak m_P}(f))$. The logarithm here is the logarithm on the integer multiplicative value group with an added zero, including its totalized value $\operatorname{log}(0)=0$; consequently this definition assigns $o_P(0)=0$. The model consists of an intermediate field $M.K$ of an algebraic closure of $ℚ(t)$ over $ℚ$ and generators $u,v$ with $u$ transcendental, $u^N+v^N=1$, and finite extension degree $[M.K:ℚ(u)]=N$. The supplied discreteness proof provides the discrete valuation ring structure used to form the valuation; no nonzero assumption on $f$ or finite residue-degree assumption is supplied.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.cusps`

For a natural number $N$, a model $M$, a proof that all its places are discrete valuation rings, and any $φ∈M.K$, this defines the set of all places $P$ for which $o_P(φ)≠0$ or $0<o_P(φ-1)$. A place is a proper valuation subring of $M.K$ containing every rational number, and $o_P(f)$ is the negative logarithm of the valuation attached to its maximal ideal, with the totalized convention $o_P(0)=0$. The model field lies between $ℚ$ and an algebraic closure of $ℚ(t)$ and is generated by $u,v$, where $u$ is transcendental, $u^N+v^N=1$, and $[M.K:ℚ(u)]=N$ is finite. There is no assumption that $φ$ is transcendental or nonconstant, nor that this set is finite; for either $φ=0$ or $φ=1$, the defined set is empty.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ramIdx`

Given a natural number $N$, a model $M$, a proof that all places are discrete valuation rings, $φ∈M.K$, and a place $P$, this integer is defined by two cases. If $φ$ belongs to the valuation subring $O_P$, reduce it to $\bar φ∈κ(P)$, take its minimal polynomial $m_{\bar φ}$ over $ℚ$, evaluate that polynomial at $φ$ in $M.K$, and return $o_P(m_{\bar φ}(φ))$; if $φ∉O_P$, return $-o_P(φ)$. Here places are proper valuation subrings containing $ℚ$, and $o_P$ is the negative logarithm of the maximal-ideal valuation with $o_P(0)=0$. The model field is an intermediate field of an algebraic closure of $ℚ(t)$ over $ℚ$, generated by $u,v$ with $u$ transcendental, $u^N+v^N=1$, and finite degree $[M.K:ℚ(u)]=N$. No finite residue-degree, algebraicity of $\bar φ$, or transcendence of $φ$ is assumed: the minimal polynomial is the totalized minimal-polynomial operation, which is zero for a nonalgebraic residue, and evaluating a zero polynomial yields order zero. The definition by itself states neither positivity nor nonvanishing of this integer.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.IsBelyi`

For a natural number $N$, a model $M$, a proof that every place is a discrete valuation ring, and $φ∈M.K$, this predicate is the conjunction of transcendence of $φ$ over $ℚ$ and the following condition: for every proper valuation subring $O_P$ of $M.K$ containing $ℚ$, if $1<r_P(φ)$, then $o_P(φ)≠0$ or $0<o_P(φ-1)$. Here $o_P(f)$ is the negative logarithm of the maximal-ideal valuation, with $o_P(0)=0$; $r_P(φ)$ is $o_P(m_{\bar φ}(φ))$ when $φ∈O_P$, where $m_{\bar φ}$ is the minimal polynomial over $ℚ$ of its residue, and is $-o_P(φ)$ otherwise. A nonalgebraic residue has zero minimal polynomial under this totalized operation. The model field is an intermediate field of an algebraic closure of $ℚ(t)$ over $ℚ$, generated by $u,v$ with $u$ transcendental, $u^N+v^N=1$, and finite degree $[M.K:ℚ(u)]=N$. There is no residue-finiteness hypothesis; the conditional places no restriction where $r_P(φ)≤1$, and neither converse implication nor finiteness of the displayed cusp set is asserted.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Divisor`

For any natural number $N$ and model $M$, this type is the type of integer-valued functions on the places of $M.K$ having finite support: a divisor is a function $D$ with $D(P)∈ℤ$ for each place and $D(P)=0$ except at finitely many places. A place is any proper valuation subring of $M.K$ containing all rational numbers. The model field is an intermediate field of an algebraic closure of $ℚ(t)$ over $ℚ$, with generators $u,v$ satisfying transcendence of $u$, $u^N+v^N=1$, and finite degree $[M.K:ℚ(u)]=N$. The type includes the zero function and functions with negative coefficients; it requires neither discreteness of the places nor finite-dimensional residue fields.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.divisorDegree`

For a natural number $N$, a model $M$, and an integer-valued finitely supported function $D$ on its places, this returns the integer sum $∑_{P∈\operatorname{supp}(D)}D(P)\,d_P$. A place is a proper valuation subring of $M.K$ containing $ℚ$, $κ(P)$ is its residue field, and  $d_P$ is the natural-valued vector-space finrank, cast into $ℤ$; finrank is zero for an infinite-dimensional residue field. The model field is an intermediate field of an algebraic closure of $ℚ(t)$ over $ℚ$, generated by $u,v$ with $u$ transcendental, $u^N+v^N=1$, and finite degree $[M.K:ℚ(u)]=N$. No discreteness or finite-residue-degree proof is an argument. Negative coefficients are permitted and the empty-support sum is zero.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.cuspDivisor`

Given a natural number $N$, a model $M$, a proof that every place is a discrete valuation ring, $φ∈M.K$, and a proof that $C={P:o_P(φ)≠0\text{ or }0<o_P(φ-1)}$ is finite, this defines the finitely supported integer-valued function $∑_{P∈C}[P]$, where $[P]$ is one at $P$ and zero at every other place. Thus the coefficient is exactly one at every place of $C$ and zero elsewhere; if $C$ is empty the divisor is zero. Places are proper valuation subrings of $M.K$ containing $ℚ$, and $o_P$ is the negative logarithm of the maximal-ideal valuation, totalized by $o_P(0)=0$. The model field is an intermediate field of an algebraic closure of $ℚ(t)$ over $ℚ$, generated by $u,v$ with $u$ transcendental, $u^N+v^N=1$, and finite degree $[M.K:ℚ(u)]=N$. Finiteness of $C$ is supplied, not proved by this definition; no transcendence assumption on $φ$ or residue-finiteness assumption is required.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.planeCanonicalDegree`

For every natural number $N$, including $N=0$, this defines the integer $N(N-3)$, with $N$ first cast to $ℤ$ and subtraction performed in $ℤ$. Its values at $N=0,1,2,3$ are respectively $0,-2,-2,0$; it is positive for $N≥4$. No curve, model, smoothness assumption, or geometric identification is an argument of this definition.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.StrictQ`

Given a natural number $N$, a model $M$, a proof that all places are discrete valuation rings, $φ∈M.K$, a proof of finiteness of $C={P:o_P(φ)≠0\text{ or }0<o_P(φ-1)}$, and a real number $q$, this predicate is exactly $(∑_{P∈C}d_P)/(N(N-3))<q$, interpreted in $ℝ$. Places are proper valuation subrings containing $ℚ$, $κ(P)$ is the residue field, and  $d_P$ denotes its natural-valued finrank, which is zero when it is infinite-dimensional. The numerator is the integer degree of the divisor with coefficient one on $C$, cast to $ℝ$; $o_P$ is the negative logarithm of the maximal-ideal valuation with $o_P(0)=0$. The model field is an intermediate field of an algebraic closure of $ℚ(t)$ over $ℚ$, generated by $u,v$ with $u$ transcendental, $u^N+v^N=1$, and finite degree $[M.K:ℚ(u)]=N$. There is no transcendence requirement on $φ$, finite-residue-degree hypothesis, sign condition on $q$, or separate condition $N>3$. The denominator is computed using integer subtraction; it is negative at $N=1,2$ and zero at $N=0,3$. Real division by zero is defined to be zero, so whenever the other input data exist and the denominator is zero the predicate reduces to $0<q$.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.AffinePoint`

For a natural number $N$ and a model $M$, this is the type of pairs consisting of a place $P$ of $M.K$ and a ring homomorphism $σ:κ(P)→\overline{ℚ}$, subject to the property that there exist proofs $u∈O_P$ and $v∈O_P$ for which $σ(\bar u)≠0$ and $σ(\bar v)≠0$. Here a place is a proper valuation subring $O_P$ containing $ℚ$, $κ(P)$ is its residue field, and the bars mean reduction of the indicated ring elements; $\overline{ℚ}$ is an algebraic closure of $ℚ$. The model field $M.K$ lies in an algebraic closure of $ℚ(t)$, is generated over $ℚ$ by $u,v$, and satisfies transcendence of $u$, $u^N+v^N=1$, and finite degree $[M.K:ℚ(u)]=N$. The ring homomorphism is part of the point, so it is not merely the underlying place. The membership proofs and nonvanishing conditions occur as an existential property defining a subtype, rather than as additional chosen point coordinates. No assumption of discrete places, finite residue degree, or existence of such a point is asserted by this type definition.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.AffineIdentification`

For any natural number $N$ and model $M$, this structure consists of a bijection $e$ from the following point type to the set of pairs $(a,b)∈\overline{ℚ}^2$ satisfying $a^N+b^N=1$, $a≠0$, and $b≠0$, together with three compatibility proofs. A point $x$ is a proper valuation subring $O_P⊂M.K$ containing $ℚ$, equipped with a ring homomorphism $σ_x:κ(P)→\overline{ℚ}$, such that $u,v∈O_P$ and their images under reduction followed by $σ_x$ are both nonzero. For every such $x$ and every proof that $u∈O_P$, the first coordinate of $e(x)$ equals $σ_x(\bar u)$; for every such $x$ and every proof that $v∈O_P$, its second coordinate equals $σ_x(\bar v)$. Finally, for every $x$, the intermediate subfield of $\overline{ℚ}$ given by the image of $σ_x$, viewed as a $ℚ$-algebra map, equals $ℚ(a,b)$ for $(a,b)=e(x)$. Here $\overline{ℚ}$ is an algebraic closure of $ℚ$, and $M.K$ is an intermediate field of an algebraic closure of $ℚ(t)$ over $ℚ$, generated by $u,v$ with $u$ transcendental, $u^N+v^N=1$, and finite degree $[M.K:ℚ(u)]=N$. The structure specifies data and compatibility, and does not assert that such data exist. No separate positivity of $N$, discreteness, or residue-finiteness hypothesis is imposed; at $N=0$ the displayed target point set is empty.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalSelection`

For any natural number $N$, any model $M$ of $N$, and a specified proof $h$ that every place ring of $M$ is a discrete valuation ring, the proposition `NoncriticalSelection M h` is defined by the following condition. Here a model of a natural number $N$ means a subfield $K$ of an algebraic closure of the rational function field $ℚ(t)$ in one indeterminate $t$, containing $ℚ$, with elements $u,v∈K$ such that $u$ is transcendental over $ℚ$, $u^N+v^N=1$, $K=ℚ(u,v)$, and $K$ is finite dimensional over $ℚ(u)$ with dimension exactly $N$. A place $P$ means a valuation subring $O_P⊊K$ containing every rational number; write $κ(P)$ for its residue field. Given the specified proof $h$ that every $O_P$ is a discrete valuation ring, define $o_P(f)$ to be minus `WithZero.log` of the value of $f$ under the valuation associated with the maximal ideal of $O_P$. This is the code’s total integer-valued function, including $o_P(0)=0$. Put $C(φ)=\{P:o_P(φ)≠0\text{ or }0<o_P(φ-1)\}$, where “or” is inclusive. Define $r_P(φ)$ as $o_P(m_{P,φ}(φ))$ if $φ∈O_P$, where $m_{P,φ}$ is the minimal polynomial over $ℚ$ of the residue of $φ$ in $κ(P)$, and as $-o_P(φ)$ otherwise; the polynomial is evaluated in $K$. The minimal-polynomial operation is total and gives the zero polynomial for a transcendental residue. For every finite set $T$ of places, including the empty set, there is $φ∈K$ transcendental over $ℚ$ such that every place with $1<r_P(φ)$ belongs to $C(φ)$, and every $P∈T$ lies outside $C(φ)$; equivalently, for these $P$, $o_P(φ)=0$ and $o_P(φ-1)≤0$. No hypothesis $N>3$ or finiteness of the residue fields over $ℚ$ is imposed. The natural-number quantifier includes $N=0$, but no model of $0$ can satisfy the required finite dimensional field-extension dimension.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalInput`

For a natural number $N$, the proposition `NoncriticalInput N` means that there exist a model $M$ of $N$ and a proof $h$ that every place ring is a discrete valuation ring, such that every $κ(P)$ is finite dimensional over $ℚ$, an affine identification exists, and the following selection and finiteness conditions hold. Here a model of a natural number $N$ means a subfield $K$ of an algebraic closure of the rational function field $ℚ(t)$ in one indeterminate $t$, containing $ℚ$, with elements $u,v∈K$ such that $u$ is transcendental over $ℚ$, $u^N+v^N=1$, $K=ℚ(u,v)$, and $K$ is finite dimensional over $ℚ(u)$ with dimension exactly $N$. A place $P$ means a valuation subring $O_P⊊K$ containing every rational number; write $κ(P)$ for its residue field. An affine point is a pair $(P,σ)$ with a unital ring homomorphism $σ:κ(P)→\overline{ℚ}$, where $\overline{ℚ}$ is an algebraic closure of $ℚ$, such that $u,v∈O_P$ and both $σ(\bar u)$ and $σ(\bar v)$ are nonzero; the bars here denote residues. An affine identification is a bijection from these points to the pairs $(a,b)∈\overline{ℚ}^2$ with $a^N+b^N=1$ and $a,b≠0$, whose coordinates at every point equal $σ(\bar u)$ and $σ(\bar v)$ for every proof of the corresponding ring memberships, and for which the image subfield $σ(κ(P))$ equals $ℚ(a,b)$ inside $\overline{ℚ}$. Given the specified proof $h$ that every $O_P$ is a discrete valuation ring, define $o_P(f)$ to be minus `WithZero.log` of the value of $f$ under the valuation associated with the maximal ideal of $O_P$. This is the code’s total integer-valued function, including $o_P(0)=0$. Put $C(φ)=\{P:o_P(φ)≠0\text{ or }0<o_P(φ-1)\}$, where “or” is inclusive. Define $r_P(φ)$ as $o_P(m_{P,φ}(φ))$ if $φ∈O_P$, where $m_{P,φ}$ is the minimal polynomial over $ℚ$ of the residue of $φ$ in $κ(P)$, and as $-o_P(φ)$ otherwise; the polynomial is evaluated in $K$. The minimal-polynomial operation is total and gives the zero polynomial for a transcendental residue. For every finite set $T$ of places, including the empty set, there is $φ∈K$ transcendental over $ℚ$ such that every place with $1<r_P(φ)$ belongs to $C(φ)$, and every $P∈T$ lies outside $C(φ)$; equivalently, for these $P$, $o_P(φ)=0$ and $o_P(φ-1)≤0$. Moreover, for every $φ∈K$ that is transcendental over $ℚ$ and satisfies $1<r_P(φ)⇒P∈C(φ)$ for every place $P$, the set $C(φ)$ is finite. The definition itself imposes no restriction $N>3$. In particular, at $N=0$ this existence condition is false, since a finite dimensional field extension cannot have dimension zero.

**简体中文**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Ω`

类型 $Ω$ 定义为有理数域上的一元有理函数域 $ℚ(t)$ 的代数闭包。这是该域的缩写，没有其他条件或参数。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Model`

对每个自然数 $N$，包括 $0$，一个模型由中间域 $ℚ ⊆ K ⊆ Ω$、元素 $u,v ∈ K$ 及以下各项的证明组成，其中 $Ω$ 是 $ℚ(t)$ 的代数闭包：$u$ 在 $ℚ$ 上超越，$u^N+v^N=1$，$K$ 内由 $u,v$ 在 $ℚ$ 上生成的中间域 $ℚ(u,v)$ 等于整个 $K$，$K$ 在子域 $ℚ(u)$ 上有限维，且 $[K:ℚ(u)]=N$。参数没有另行规定正性条件；当 $N=0$ 时，这些数据和证明不可能存在，因为所要求的方程是在特征为零的域中满足 $1+1=1$。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Model.trdeg_eq_one`

对任意自然数 $N$，以及任意中间域 $ℚ ⊆ K ⊆ Ω$ 和元素 $u,v ∈ K$，其中 $Ω$ 是 $ℚ(t)$ 的代数闭包，如果 $u$ 在 $ℚ$ 上超越、$u^N+v^N=1$、$ℚ(u,v)=K$、$K$ 在 $ℚ(u)$ 上有限维且 $[K:ℚ(u)]=N$，则 $K$ 在 $ℚ$ 上的超越次数恰好为 $1$。量化也包括 $N=0$，但此时不存在满足这些条件的模型。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place`

对任意域 $K$，赋值处的类型定义为满足以下条件的赋值子环 $O$ 所组成的集合：$O$ 是真子环，即 $O ≠ K$，且每个 $q ∈ ℚ$ 在 $K$ 中的有理数转换值都属于 $O$。这里，赋值子环是指对每个 $a ∈ K$ 都有 $a ∈ O$ 或 $a^{-1} ∈ O$ 的子环。此定义不假设特征为零；在任意特征下，包含条件使用既定的有理数转换，而不要求 $ℚ$ 到 $K$ 的嵌入。定义不要求赋值离散，也不要求剩余域有限维。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.ResidueField`

对域 $K$ 和赋值处 $P$，即包含每个有理数在 $K$ 中的转换值的真赋值子环 $O ⊊ K$，$P$ 的剩余域定义为局部环 $O$ 的剩余域，即 $κ(P)=O/𝔪_O$，其中 $𝔪_O$ 是 $O$ 的唯一极大理想。这里没有对该商域施加有限维条件。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.residue`

对域 $K$ 和由包含所有有理数转换值的真赋值子环 $O ⊊ K$ 给出的赋值处 $P$，此定义给出保单位元的环同态 $O → κ(P)=O/𝔪_O$，把 $O$ 中的元素映为它模唯一极大理想 $𝔪_O$ 的剩余类。该映射的定义域是赋值子环 $O$，并非整个 $K$。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.ratHom`

对每个特征为零的域 $K$ 和每个赋值处 $P$，其中 $P$ 由包含所有有理数转换值的真赋值子环 $O ⊊ K$ 表示，此定义把通常的有理数嵌入 $ℚ → K$ 的陪域限制为 $O$，得到保单位元的环同态 $ℚ → O$。它把每个有理数 $q$ 映为 $q$ 在 $K$ 中的像，并利用 $P$ 的包含条件将此像视为 $O$ 的元素。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.degree`

对特征为零的域 $K$ 和由包含所有有理数的真赋值子环 $O ⊊ K$ 给出的赋值处 $P$，$P$ 的次数定义为剩余域 $κ(P)=O/𝔪_O$ 作为 $ℚ$ 上向量空间的自然数值有限秩，其中有理数标量结构由剩余映射诱导。当该向量空间有限维时，此值为其维数 $[κ(P):ℚ]$；当它无限维时，有限秩的此项约定给出 $0$。这里没有有限维假设。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.QbarPoint`

对每个特征为零的域 $K$，此类型的一个点由赋值处 $P$ 以及保单位元的环同态 $σ:κ(P) → ℚ̄$ 组成，其中 $P$ 是包含有理数的真赋值子环 $O ⊊ K$，$κ(P)=O/𝔪_O$ 是其剩余域，$ℚ̄$ 是 $ℚ$ 的代数闭包。该同态，即将剩余域嵌入 $ℚ̄$ 的具体选择，是数据的一部分。此结构没有包含剩余域有限维的假设。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.QbarPoint.eval`

对任意特征为零的域 $K$、由包含 $ℚ$ 的真赋值子环 $O ⊊ K$ 和保单位元的环同态 $σ:O/𝔪_O → ℚ̄$ 组成的任意点 $x$、任意元素 $f ∈ K$ 以及任意 $f ∈ O$ 的证明，求值定义为 $σ(f+𝔪_O) ∈ ℚ̄$，其中 $ℚ̄$ 是 $ℚ$ 的代数闭包。也就是说，先取 $f$ 在剩余域中的剩余类，再应用选定的同态；$f$ 属于 $O$ 的证明是此定义要求的一个参数。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.QbarPoint.fieldOf`

对特征为零的域 $K$，以及由包含 $ℚ$ 的真赋值子环 $O ⊊ K$ 和保单位元的环同态 $σ:κ → ℚ̄$ 组成的点 $x$，与 $x$ 关联的域定义为介于 $ℚ$ 与 $ℚ̄$ 之间的中间域 $σ(κ)$，其中 $κ=O/𝔪_O$，$ℚ̄$ 是 $ℚ$ 的代数闭包。这是将 $σ$ 视为有理数代数同态时整个剩余域的像；等价地，其元素恰为所有 $a ∈ κ$ 的像 $σ(a)$。此定义不包含有限维断言。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.QbarPoint.degree`

对特征为零的域 $K$，以及由包含 $ℚ$ 的真赋值子环 $O ⊊ K$ 和保单位元的环同态 $σ:O/𝔪_O → ℚ̄$ 组成的点 $x$，$x$ 的次数定义为中间域 $σ(O/𝔪_O) ⊆ ℚ̄$ 在 $ℚ$ 上的自然数值有限秩，其中 $ℚ̄$ 是 $ℚ$ 的代数闭包。当这个像域在 $ℚ$ 上有限维时，此值为其扩张次数；当它无限维时，有限秩的约定给出 $0$。这里不假设有限维性。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.QbarPoint.eval_mem_fieldOf`

对每个特征为零的域 $K$、每个由包含 $ℚ$ 的真赋值子环 $O ⊊ K$ 和保单位元的环同态 $σ:κ → ℚ̄$ 组成的点 $x$、每个元素 $f ∈ K$ 以及每个 $f ∈ O$ 的证明，求值结果 $σ(f+𝔪_O)$ 都属于中间域 $σ(κ) ⊆ ℚ̄$，其中 $κ=O/𝔪_O$，$ℚ̄$ 是 $ℚ$ 的代数闭包。这里的求值是 $f$ 的剩余类在 $σ$ 下的像，该中间域是整个剩余域的像；无需假设 $f$ 非零，也无需假设该域有限维。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.PlacesDiscrete`

对任意自然数 $N$ 和模型 $M$，此谓词表示：$M.K$ 的每个包含所有有理数之像的真赋值子环 $O$ 都是离散赋值环。这里 $M.K$ 是 $ℚ$ 与 $ℚ(t)$ 的某个代数闭包之间的中间域，带有元素 $u,v$，满足 $u$ 在 $ℚ$ 上超越、$u^N+v^N=1$、$ℚ(u,v)=M.K$，并且 $M.K$ 在 $ℚ(u)$ 上有限维且维数为 $N$。一个位恰指这样的真赋值子环；此谓词不要求剩余域的次数有限，也不选取剩余域的嵌入。参数 $N$ 没有单独给出的正性假设。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ResiduesFinite`

对任意自然数 $N$ 和模型 $M$，此谓词表示：对 $M.K$ 中每个包含所有有理数的真赋值子环 $O$，剩余域 $κ(O)$ 都是 $ℚ$ 上的有限维向量空间。这里 $M.K$ 是 $ℚ$ 在 $ℚ(t)$ 的某个代数闭包中的中间域，带有元素 $u,v$，满足 $u$ 在 $ℚ$ 上超越、$u^N+v^N=1$、$ℚ(u,v)=M.K$，以及有限扩张次数 $[M.K:ℚ(u)]=N$。$κ(O)$ 上的有理数结构由 $O$ 中有理数的剩余像给出。此谓词不要求这些维数有共同上界，本身也不要求 $O$ 是离散赋值环；$N$ 没有单独给出的正性假设。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ord`

给定自然数 $N$、模型 $M$、每个包含 $ℚ$ 的 $M.K$ 真赋值子环都是离散赋值环的证明、这样的位 $P$，以及任意 $f∈M.K$，这个整数值定义返回 $P$ 的极大理想所附赋值在 $f$ 处取值的乘法整数群对数的相反数，即 $o_P(f)=-\operatorname{log}(v_{\mathfrak m_P}(f))$。这里对数定义在添加了零的乘法整数值群上，采用全定义约定 $\operatorname{log}(0)=0$，所以 $o_P(0)=0$。模型由 $ℚ$ 在 $ℚ(t)$ 的某个代数闭包中的中间域 $M.K$ 及其生成元 $u,v$ 构成，满足 $u$ 超越、$u^N+v^N=1$，以及有限扩张次数 $[M.K:ℚ(u)]=N$。所给离散性证明提供构造赋值所需的离散赋值环结构；既不假设 $f$ 非零，也不假设剩余域次数有限。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.cusps`

对自然数 $N$、模型 $M$、其所有位均为离散赋值环的证明，以及任意 $φ∈M.K$，此定义给出满足 $o_P(φ)≠0$ 或 $0<o_P(φ-1)$ 的所有位 $P$ 组成的集合。位是包含所有有理数的 $M.K$ 真赋值子环；$o_P(f)$ 是其极大理想所附赋值的对数的相反数，并采用全定义约定 $o_P(0)=0$。模型域位于 $ℚ$ 与 $ℚ(t)$ 的某个代数闭包之间，由 $u,v$ 生成，其中 $u$ 超越、$u^N+v^N=1$，且有限扩张次数 $[M.K:ℚ(u)]=N$。这里不假设 $φ$ 超越或非常数，也不假设所得集合有限；当 $φ=0$ 或 $φ=1$ 时，此集合为空。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ramIdx`

给定自然数 $N$、模型 $M$、所有位均为离散赋值环的证明、$φ∈M.K$ 和位 $P$，此整数按两种情形定义：若 $φ$ 属于赋值子环 $O_P$，先将它约化为 $\bar φ∈κ(P)$，取其在 $ℚ$ 上的最小多项式 $m_{\bar φ}$，再在 $M.K$ 中将 $φ$ 代入该多项式，返回 $o_P(m_{\bar φ}(φ))$；若 $φ∉O_P$，返回 $-o_P(φ)$。这里位是真赋值子环且包含 $ℚ$，$o_P$ 是极大理想赋值的对数的相反数，并约定 $o_P(0)=0$。模型域是 $ℚ$ 在 $ℚ(t)$ 的某个代数闭包中的中间域，由 $u,v$ 生成，满足 $u$ 超越、$u^N+v^N=1$，以及有限次数 $[M.K:ℚ(u)]=N$。这里不假设剩余域次数有限、$\bar φ$ 代数或 $φ$ 超越；最小多项式使用全定义运算，剩余元不代数时取零多项式，零多项式的代入值的阶为零。定义本身既不断言这个整数为正，也不断言它非零。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.IsBelyi`

对自然数 $N$、模型 $M$、每个位均为离散赋值环的证明，以及 $φ∈M.K$，此谓词是以下两项的合取：$φ$ 在 $ℚ$ 上超越；并且对每个包含 $ℚ$ 的 $M.K$ 真赋值子环 $O_P$，若 $1<r_P(φ)$，则 $o_P(φ)≠0$ 或 $0<o_P(φ-1)$。这里 $o_P(f)$ 是极大理想赋值的对数的相反数，且 $o_P(0)=0$；当 $φ∈O_P$ 时，$r_P(φ)=o_P(m_{\bar φ}(φ))$，其中 $m_{\bar φ}$ 是其剩余元在 $ℚ$ 上的最小多项式，否则 $r_P(φ)=-o_P(φ)$。全定义的最小多项式运算对非代数剩余元取零多项式。模型域是 $ℚ$ 在 $ℚ(t)$ 的某个代数闭包中的中间域，由 $u,v$ 生成，满足 $u$ 超越、$u^N+v^N=1$，以及有限次数 $[M.K:ℚ(u)]=N$。这里没有剩余域有限维假设；当 $r_P(φ)≤1$ 时，条件不作限制，也不断言逆向蕴含或上述尖点集合有限。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Divisor`

对任意自然数 $N$ 和模型 $M$，此类型由 $M.K$ 的位上的有限支撑整数值函数组成：一个除子是函数 $D$，对每个位 $P$ 有 $D(P)∈ℤ$，且除有限多个位外均有 $D(P)=0$。位是包含所有有理数的任意 $M.K$ 真赋值子环。模型域是 $ℚ$ 在 $ℚ(t)$ 的某个代数闭包中的中间域，由 $u,v$ 生成，满足 $u$ 超越、$u^N+v^N=1$，以及有限次数 $[M.K:ℚ(u)]=N$。此类型包括零函数和具有负系数的函数，既不要求各位离散，也不要求剩余域有限维。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.divisorDegree`

给定自然数 $N$、模型 $M$ 及其各位上的有限支撑整数值函数 $D$，此定义返回整数 $∑_{P∈\operatorname{supp}(D)}D(P)\,d_P$。位是包含 $ℚ$ 的 $M.K$ 真赋值子环，$κ(P)$ 是其剩余域， $d_P$ 指向量空间的自然数值有限秩，再转为整数；剩余域无限维时此有限秩为零。模型域是 $ℚ$ 在 $ℚ(t)$ 的某个代数闭包中的中间域，由 $u,v$ 生成，满足 $u$ 超越、$u^N+v^N=1$，以及有限次数 $[M.K:ℚ(u)]=N$。此定义的参数中没有离散性证明或剩余域次数有限的证明。允许负系数，支撑为空时和为零。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.cuspDivisor`

给定自然数 $N$、模型 $M$、每个位均为离散赋值环的证明、$φ∈M.K$，以及集合 $C={P:o_P(φ)≠0\text{ 或 }0<o_P(φ-1)}$ 有限的证明，此定义给出有限支撑整数值函数 $∑_{P∈C}[P]$，其中 $[P]$ 在 $P$ 处为一，在其他各位处为零。因此，$C$ 中每个位的系数恰为一，其余位的系数为零；若 $C$ 为空，则该除子为零。位是包含 $ℚ$ 的 $M.K$ 真赋值子环，$o_P$ 是极大理想赋值的对数的相反数，采用全定义约定 $o_P(0)=0$。模型域是 $ℚ$ 在 $ℚ(t)$ 的某个代数闭包中的中间域，由 $u,v$ 生成，满足 $u$ 超越、$u^N+v^N=1$，以及有限次数 $[M.K:ℚ(u)]=N$。$C$ 的有限性是给定参数，此定义不证明它；也不要求 $φ$ 超越或剩余域有限维。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.planeCanonicalDegree`

对每个自然数 $N$，包括 $N=0$，此定义给出整数 $N(N-3)$，其中先把 $N$ 转为整数，再作整数减法。它在 $N=0,1,2,3$ 时的值依次为 $0,-2,-2,0$，在 $N≥4$ 时为正。此定义的参数中没有曲线、模型、光滑性假设或几何对应。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.StrictQ`

给定自然数 $N$、模型 $M$、所有位均为离散赋值环的证明、$φ∈M.K$、集合 $C={P:o_P(φ)≠0\text{ 或 }0<o_P(φ-1)}$ 有限的证明，以及实数 $q$，此谓词恰为实数不等式 $(∑_{P∈C}d_P)/(N(N-3))<q$。位是包含 $ℚ$ 的真赋值子环，$κ(P)$ 是剩余域， $d_P$ 是其自然数值有限秩，在无限维时为零。分子是在 $C$ 上系数为一的除子的整数次数转为实数后的值；$o_P$ 是极大理想赋值的对数的相反数，且 $o_P(0)=0$。模型域是 $ℚ$ 在 $ℚ(t)$ 的某个代数闭包中的中间域，由 $u,v$ 生成，满足 $u$ 超越、$u^N+v^N=1$，以及有限次数 $[M.K:ℚ(u)]=N$。这里不要求 $φ$ 超越、剩余域次数有限或 $q$ 满足符号条件，也不单独要求 $N>3$。分母采用整数减法，在 $N=1,2$ 时为负，在 $N=0,3$ 时为零。实数除以零定义为零，故只要其他输入数据存在且分母为零，此谓词就化为 $0<q$。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.AffinePoint`

对自然数 $N$ 和模型 $M$，此类型的元素由 $M.K$ 的一个位 $P$ 与环同态 $σ:κ(P)→\overline{ℚ}$ 组成，并须满足如下性质：存在 $u∈O_P$ 与 $v∈O_P$ 的证明，使 $σ(\bar u)≠0$ 且 $σ(\bar v)≠0$。这里位是包含 $ℚ$ 的真赋值子环 $O_P$，$κ(P)$ 是其剩余域，上横线表示相应环元素的约化，$\overline{ℚ}$ 是 $ℚ$ 的某个代数闭包。模型域 $M.K$ 位于 $ℚ(t)$ 的某个代数闭包中，由 $u,v$ 在 $ℚ$ 上生成，满足 $u$ 超越、$u^N+v^N=1$，以及有限次数 $[M.K:ℚ(u)]=N$。环同态是点的数据的一部分，因此点不只是底层的位。成员资格证明及非零条件作为定义子类型的存在性质出现，并非额外选择的点坐标。此类型定义不假设各位离散或剩余域次数有限，也不断言这样的点存在。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.AffineIdentification`

对任意自然数 $N$ 和模型 $M$，此结构由下述点类型到满足 $a^N+b^N=1$、$a≠0$、$b≠0$ 的二元组 $(a,b)∈\overline{ℚ}^2$ 所成集合的一个双射 $e$，以及三项相容性证明组成。点 $x$ 是包含 $ℚ$ 的真赋值子环 $O_P⊂M.K$，附带环同态 $σ_x:κ(P)→\overline{ℚ}$，满足 $u,v∈O_P$，且它们先约化再经 $σ_x$ 得到的像都非零。对每个这样的 $x$ 和每个 $u∈O_P$ 的证明，$e(x)$ 的第一坐标等于 $σ_x(\bar u)$；对每个这样的 $x$ 和每个 $v∈O_P$ 的证明，第二坐标等于 $σ_x(\bar v)$。最后，对每个 $x$，将 $σ_x$ 视为 $ℚ$ 代数同态所得的像中间域，等于 $ℚ(a,b)$，其中 $(a,b)=e(x)$。这里 $\overline{ℚ}$ 是 $ℚ$ 的某个代数闭包，$M.K$ 是 $ℚ$ 在 $ℚ(t)$ 的某个代数闭包中的中间域，由 $u,v$ 生成，满足 $u$ 超越、$u^N+v^N=1$，以及有限次数 $[M.K:ℚ(u)]=N$。此结构规定数据及其相容性，并不断言这样的数据存在。这里没有单独的 $N$ 正性、离散性或剩余域有限维假设；当 $N=0$ 时，所述目标点集为空。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalSelection`

对任意自然数 $N$、其任意模型 $M$，以及每个赋值处的环都是离散赋值环的指定证明 $h$，命题 `NoncriticalSelection M h` 定义为如下条件。 这里，自然数 $N$ 的一个模型是 单不定元 $t$ 的有理函数域 $ℚ(t)$ 的代数闭包中包含 $ℚ$ 的子域 $K$，以及元素 $u,v∈K$，满足 $u$ 在 $ℚ$ 上超越、$u^N+v^N=1$、$K=ℚ(u,v)$，且 $K$ 在 $ℚ(u)$ 上为有限维，维数恰为 $N$。赋值处 $P$ 指包含所有有理数的真赋值子环 $O_P⊊K$；其剩余域记为 $κ(P)$。 给定每个 $O_P$ 都是离散赋值环的指定证明 $h$，令 $o_P(f)$ 为与 $O_P$ 的极大理想对应的赋值在 $f$ 上的值经 `WithZero.log` 运算所得整数的相反数。这是代码中的全定义整数值函数，包括 $o_P(0)=0$。令 $C(φ)$ 为满足 $o_P(φ)≠0$ 或 $0<o_P(φ-1)$ 的所有赋值处的集合，其中“或”为可兼容的或。若 $φ∈O_P$，令 $r_P(φ)=o_P(m_{P,φ}(φ))$，其中 $m_{P,φ}$ 是 $φ$ 在 $κ(P)$ 中的剩余类在 $ℚ$ 上的极小多项式，多项式在 $K$ 中求值；否则令 $r_P(φ)=-o_P(φ)$。极小多项式运算为全定义运算，对超越的剩余类给出零多项式。 对赋值处的每个有限集合 $T$，包括空集，都存在在 $ℚ$ 上超越的 $φ∈K$，使每个满足 $1<r_P(φ)$ 的赋值处都属于 $C(φ)$，且每个 $P∈T$ 都不属于 $C(φ)$；后一个条件等价于对这些 $P$ 有 $o_P(φ)=0$ 且 $o_P(φ-1)≤0$。 这里不假定 $N>3$，也不假定剩余域在 $ℚ$ 上为有限维。 自然数的量词包括 $N=0$，但零的模型不可能满足所要求的有限维域扩张维数。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalInput`

对自然数 $N$，命题 `NoncriticalInput N` 表示存在 $N$ 的一个模型 $M$，以及每个赋值处的环都是离散赋值环的证明 $h$，使每个 $κ(P)$ 在 $ℚ$ 上为有限维、存在一个仿射对应，并且下述选择条件与有限性条件成立。 这里，自然数 $N$ 的一个模型是 单不定元 $t$ 的有理函数域 $ℚ(t)$ 的代数闭包中包含 $ℚ$ 的子域 $K$，以及元素 $u,v∈K$，满足 $u$ 在 $ℚ$ 上超越、$u^N+v^N=1$、$K=ℚ(u,v)$，且 $K$ 在 $ℚ(u)$ 上为有限维，维数恰为 $N$。赋值处 $P$ 指包含所有有理数的真赋值子环 $O_P⊊K$；其剩余域记为 $κ(P)$。 一个仿射点是二元组 $(P,σ)$，其中 $σ:κ(P)→\overline{ℚ}$ 为保单位元的环同态，$\overline{ℚ}$ 为 $ℚ$ 的代数闭包，并且 $u,v∈O_P$，$σ(\bar u)$ 与 $σ(\bar v)$ 均非零；这里元素上的横线表示剩余类。一个仿射对应是从这些点到满足 $a^N+b^N=1$ 且 $a,b≠0$ 的二元组 $(a,b)∈\overline{ℚ}^2$ 的双射，要求对每一点及相应环成员关系的每一证明，两个坐标分别等于 $σ(\bar u)$ 与 $σ(\bar v)$，并要求 $\overline{ℚ}$ 中的像子域 $σ(κ(P))$ 恰等于 $ℚ(a,b)$。 给定每个 $O_P$ 都是离散赋值环的指定证明 $h$，令 $o_P(f)$ 为与 $O_P$ 的极大理想对应的赋值在 $f$ 上的值经 `WithZero.log` 运算所得整数的相反数。这是代码中的全定义整数值函数，包括 $o_P(0)=0$。令 $C(φ)$ 为满足 $o_P(φ)≠0$ 或 $0<o_P(φ-1)$ 的所有赋值处的集合，其中“或”为可兼容的或。若 $φ∈O_P$，令 $r_P(φ)=o_P(m_{P,φ}(φ))$，其中 $m_{P,φ}$ 是 $φ$ 在 $κ(P)$ 中的剩余类在 $ℚ$ 上的极小多项式，多项式在 $K$ 中求值；否则令 $r_P(φ)=-o_P(φ)$。极小多项式运算为全定义运算，对超越的剩余类给出零多项式。 对赋值处的每个有限集合 $T$，包括空集，都存在在 $ℚ$ 上超越的 $φ∈K$，使每个满足 $1<r_P(φ)$ 的赋值处都属于 $C(φ)$，且每个 $P∈T$ 都不属于 $C(φ)$；后一个条件等价于对这些 $P$ 有 $o_P(φ)=0$ 且 $o_P(φ-1)≤0$。 此外，对每个在 $ℚ$ 上超越且对所有赋值处 $P$ 满足 $1<r_P(φ)⇒P∈C(φ)$ 的 $φ∈K$，集合 $C(φ)$ 都有限。 该定义本身没有施加 $N>3$ 的限制。 特别地，当 $N=0$ 时，该存在性条件为假，因为有限维域扩张的维数不可能为零。

**日本語**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Ω`

型 $Ω$ を、有理数体上の一変数有理関数体 $ℚ(t)$ の代数閉包と定義する。これは当該体の略記であり、追加の条件やパラメータはない。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Model`

各自然数 $N$ に対し、$0$ も含めて、モデルとは、中間体 $ℚ ⊆ K ⊆ Ω$ と元 $u,v ∈ K$、および次の各条件の証明からなる構造である。ここで $Ω$ は $ℚ(t)$ の代数閉包である。条件は、$u$ が $ℚ$ 上超越的であること、$u^N+v^N=1$、$K$ 内の中間体 $ℚ(u,v)$ が $K$ 全体に等しいこと、$K$ が部分体 $ℚ(u)$ 上有限次元であること、および $[K:ℚ(u)]=N$ である。パラメータの正値性は別途仮定されていないが、$N=0$ では必要な等式が標数零の体における $1+1=1$ となるため、この構造の元は存在しない。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Model.trdeg_eq_one`

任意の自然数 $N$ と、$Ω$ を $ℚ(t)$ の代数閉包としたときの任意の中間体 $ℚ ⊆ K ⊆ Ω$、および元 $u,v ∈ K$ について、$u$ が $ℚ$ 上超越的であり、$u^N+v^N=1$、$ℚ(u,v)=K$ が成り立ち、さらに $K$ が $ℚ(u)$ 上有限次元で $[K:ℚ(u)]=N$ であれば、$K$ の $ℚ$ 上の超越次数はちょうど $1$ である。量化には $N=0$ も含まれるが、その場合にはこれらの条件を満たすモデルは存在しない。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place`

任意の体 $K$ に対し、素点の型を、$K$ の付値部分環 $O$ のうち、真の部分環であり、すなわち $O ≠ K$ であり、かつすべての $q ∈ ℚ$ の $K$ における有理数キャストを含むものの集合と定義する。付値部分環とは、各 $a ∈ K$ について $a ∈ O$ または $a^{-1} ∈ O$ が成り立つ部分環である。この定義には標数零の仮定はなく、任意の標数における包含条件は、$ℚ$ の埋め込みを要求するのではなく、与えられた有理数キャストを用いる。付値の離散性も剰余体の有限次元性も要求されない。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.ResidueField`

体 $K$ とその素点 $P$、すなわちすべての有理数の $K$ におけるキャストを含む真の付値部分環 $O ⊊ K$ に対し、$P$ の剰余体を局所環 $O$ の剰余体 $κ(P)=O/𝔪_O$ と定義する。ここで $𝔪_O$ は $O$ の唯一の極大イデアルである。この商体の有限次元性は仮定されていない。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.residue`

任意の自然数 $N$、その任意のモデル $M$、および各素点の環が離散付値環であるという指定された証明 $h$ に対して、命題 `NoncriticalSelection M h` は次の条件として定義される。 ここで自然数 $N$ のモデルとは、一つの不定元 $t$ による有理関数体 $ℚ(t)$ の代数閉包の中の $ℚ$ を含む部分体 $K$ と、$ℚ$ 上超越的な元 $u$ および元 $v∈K$ であって、$u^N+v^N=1$、$K=ℚ(u,v)$、かつ $K$ が $ℚ(u)$ 上有限次元でその次元がちょうど $N$ となるものをいう。素点 $P$ は、すべての有理数を含む真の付値部分環 $O_P⊊K$ を意味し、その剰余体を $κ(P)$ と書く。 各 $O_P$ が離散付値環であるという指定された証明 $h$ に対し、$o_P(f)$ を、$O_P$ の極大イデアルに付随する付値による $f$ の値に `WithZero.log` を適用した整数の負と定める。これはコードの全域的な整数値関数であり、$o_P(0)=0$ を含む。$C(φ)$ は $o_P(φ)≠0$ または $0<o_P(φ-1)$ を満たすすべての素点の集合とする。「または」は両方が成り立つ場合を含む。$φ∈O_P$ のとき、$φ$ の $κ(P)$ における剰余類の $ℚ$ 上の最小多項式を $m_{P,φ}$ として、$r_P(φ)=o_P(m_{P,φ}(φ))$ と定める。多項式は $K$ で評価する。$φ∉O_P$ のときは $r_P(φ)=-o_P(φ)$ とする。最小多項式の演算は全域的であり、剰余類が超越的な場合には零多項式を与える。 空集合を含む素点の任意の有限集合 $T$ に対して、$ℚ$ 上超越的な元 $φ∈K$ が存在し、$1<r_P(φ)$ を満たす各素点が $C(φ)$ に属し、かつすべての $P∈T$ が $C(φ)$ に属さない。後者はこれらの $P$ について $o_P(φ)=0$ かつ $o_P(φ-1)≤0$ となることと同値である。 $N>3$ や剰余体の $ℚ$ 上の有限次元性は仮定されない。 自然数の量化には $N=0$ も含まれるが、零のモデルは要求される有限次元の体拡大の次元条件を満たし得ない。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalInput`

自然数 $N$ に対する命題 `NoncriticalInput N` は、$N$ のモデル $M$ と各素点の環が離散付値環である証明 $h$ が存在し、各 $κ(P)$ が $ℚ$ 上有限次元であり、アフィン同定が存在し、次の選択条件と有限性条件が成り立つことを意味する。 ここで自然数 $N$ のモデルとは、一つの不定元 $t$ による有理関数体 $ℚ(t)$ の代数閉包の中の $ℚ$ を含む部分体 $K$ と、$ℚ$ 上超越的な元 $u$ および元 $v∈K$ であって、$u^N+v^N=1$、$K=ℚ(u,v)$、かつ $K$ が $ℚ(u)$ 上有限次元でその次元がちょうど $N$ となるものをいう。素点 $P$ は、すべての有理数を含む真の付値部分環 $O_P⊊K$ を意味し、その剰余体を $κ(P)$ と書く。 アフィン点とは、$ℚ$ の代数閉包 $\overline{ℚ}$ への単位元を保つ環準同型 $σ:κ(P)→\overline{ℚ}$ を備えた組 $(P,σ)$ で、$u,v∈O_P$ かつ $σ(\bar u),σ(\bar v)≠0$ を満たすものをいう。ここで元の上の横線は剰余類を表す。アフィン同定とは、これらの点から $a^N+b^N=1$ および $a,b≠0$ を満たす組 $(a,b)∈\overline{ℚ}^2$ への全単射であって、各点と対応する環への所属の任意の証明に対して座標がそれぞれ $σ(\bar u),σ(\bar v)$ に等しく、さらに $\overline{ℚ}$ 内の像部分体 $σ(κ(P))$ が $ℚ(a,b)$ に等しいものをいう。 各 $O_P$ が離散付値環であるという指定された証明 $h$ に対し、$o_P(f)$ を、$O_P$ の極大イデアルに付随する付値による $f$ の値に `WithZero.log` を適用した整数の負と定める。これはコードの全域的な整数値関数であり、$o_P(0)=0$ を含む。$C(φ)$ は $o_P(φ)≠0$ または $0<o_P(φ-1)$ を満たすすべての素点の集合とする。「または」は両方が成り立つ場合を含む。$φ∈O_P$ のとき、$φ$ の $κ(P)$ における剰余類の $ℚ$ 上の最小多項式を $m_{P,φ}$ として、$r_P(φ)=o_P(m_{P,φ}(φ))$ と定める。多項式は $K$ で評価する。$φ∉O_P$ のときは $r_P(φ)=-o_P(φ)$ とする。最小多項式の演算は全域的であり、剰余類が超越的な場合には零多項式を与える。 空集合を含む素点の任意の有限集合 $T$ に対して、$ℚ$ 上超越的な元 $φ∈K$ が存在し、$1<r_P(φ)$ を満たす各素点が $C(φ)$ に属し、かつすべての $P∈T$ が $C(φ)$ に属さない。後者はこれらの $P$ について $o_P(φ)=0$ かつ $o_P(φ-1)≤0$ となることと同値である。 さらに、$ℚ$ 上超越的であり、すべての素点 $P$ に対して $1<r_P(φ)⇒P∈C(φ)$ を満たす任意の $φ∈K$ について、集合 $C(φ)$ は有限である。 この定義自体には $N>3$ という制限はない。 特に $N=0$ では、有限次元の体拡大の次元は零にならないため、この存在条件は偽である。

/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: The Belyi project contributors

Independent minimal adaptation of CurveField/{Basic,Place,Residue,Point,
NoncriticalBasic}.lean at 9ce4d3f793d3bc831f2fc7214b7dbad90ea012d8.
The Fermat presentation is new and fixed by explicit equations and degree.
No existence or regularity theorem is silently installed as an instance.
-/
import Definitions.Def_TripodFermatInputs
import Mathlib.FieldTheory.RatFunc.Basic
import Mathlib.Algebra.Algebra.Hom.Rat
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Valuation.ValuationSubring
import Mathlib.RingTheory.DedekindDomain.AdicValuation
import Mathlib.RingTheory.DedekindDomain.Dvr
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Valuation.Discrete.IsDiscreteValuationRing
import Mathlib.Data.Finsupp.Basic
import Mathlib.RingTheory.AlgebraicIndependent.AlgebraicClosure
import Mathlib.RingTheory.AlgebraicIndependent.TranscendenceBasis

set_option autoImplicit false

open scoped IntermediateField WithZero

namespace AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper

abbrev Ω : Type := AlgebraicClosure (RatFunc ℚ)

/-- An actual presentation of the Fermat function field. The degree-N condition
rules out a proper factor of V^N−(1−U^N); transcendence and generation rule out
an algebraic or larger unrelated field. Existence is a separate open node. -/
structure Model (N : ℕ) where
  K : IntermediateField ℚ Ω
  u : K
  v : K
  transcendental_u : Transcendental ℚ u
  equation : u ^ N + v ^ N = 1
  generate : ℚ⟮u, v⟯ = ⊤
  finite_u : FiniteDimensional ℚ⟮u⟯ K
  degree_u : Module.finrank ℚ⟮u⟯ K = N

/-- Transcendence degree one follows from the explicit presentation;
it is not another assumed structural field. -/
theorem Model.trdeg_eq_one {N : ℕ} (M : Model N) : Algebra.trdeg ℚ M.K = 1 := by
  letI : FiniteDimensional ℚ⟮M.u⟯ M.K := M.finite_u
  have ht : IsTranscendenceBasis ℚ (fun _ : Unit => M.u) := by
    refine (algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff.mpr M.transcendental_u).isTranscendenceBasis_iff_isAlgebraic.mpr ?_
    rw [Set.range_const, ← IntermediateField.isAlgebraic_adjoin_iff_top]
    infer_instance
  have := ht.lift_cardinalMk_eq_trdeg
  simpa using this.symm

/-- The actual valuative closed-point carrier of a curve function field.
No affine chart is selected, so places at infinity are included. -/
abbrev Place (K : Type*) [Field K] : Type _ :=
  {O : ValuationSubring K // O ≠ ⊤ ∧ ∀ q : ℚ, (q : K) ∈ O}

namespace Place

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]

abbrev ResidueField (P : Place K) : Type _ := IsLocalRing.ResidueField P.1

noncomputable def residue (P : Place K) : P.1 →+* P.ResidueField :=
  IsLocalRing.residue P.1

noncomputable def ratHom (P : Place K) : ℚ →+* P.1 :=
  (Rat.castHom K).codRestrict P.1 P.2.2

instance (P : Place K) : CharZero P.ResidueField :=
  charZero_of_injective_ringHom (P.residue.comp P.ratHom).injective

noncomputable def degree (P : Place K) : ℕ :=
  Module.finrank ℚ P.ResidueField

end Place

/-- A genuine algebraic point on the regular proper model, including its
residue-field embedding into the fixed algebraic closure of ℚ. -/
structure QbarPoint (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] where
  P : Place K
  σ : P.ResidueField →+* Qbar

namespace QbarPoint

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]

noncomputable def eval (x : QbarPoint K) (f : K) (hf : f ∈ x.P.1) : Qbar :=
  x.σ (x.P.residue ⟨f, hf⟩)

noncomputable def fieldOf (x : QbarPoint K) : IntermediateField ℚ Qbar :=
  x.σ.toRatAlgHom.fieldRange

noncomputable def degree (x : QbarPoint K) : ℕ :=
  Module.finrank ℚ x.fieldOf

theorem eval_mem_fieldOf (x : QbarPoint K) (f : K) (hf : f ∈ x.P.1) :
    x.eval f hf ∈ x.fieldOf :=
  ⟨x.P.residue ⟨f, hf⟩, rfl⟩

end QbarPoint

variable {N : ℕ}

/-- Precise regularity obligation, independently supplied. The type makes no
choice of valuation or ramification law. -/
def PlacesDiscrete (M : Model N) : Prop :=
  ∀ P : Place M.K, IsDiscreteValuationRing P.1

/-- Precise residue-field finiteness obligation, independently supplied. -/
def ResiduesFinite (M : Model N) : Prop :=
  ∀ P : Place M.K, FiniteDimensional ℚ P.ResidueField

/-- The source's normalized discrete order, parameterized by the explicit
regularity theorem. This is not an arbitrary order-valued function. -/
noncomputable def ord (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M)
    (P : Place M.K) (f : M.K) : ℤ := by
  letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing P.1 := hDVR P
  exact -WithZero.log (((IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal P.1).valuation M.K) f)

/-- Actual cusps, at zeros, poles, or value one, including places at infinity. -/
def cusps (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M) (φ : M.K) : Set (Place M.K) :=
  {P | ord M hDVR P φ ≠ 0 ∨ 0 < ord M hDVR P (φ - 1)}

/-- The ramification index computed by the minimal polynomial of the residue,
or minus the pole order. Residue finiteness makes this the geometric index. -/
noncomputable def ramIdx (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M)
    (φ : M.K) (P : Place M.K) : ℤ := by
  classical
  exact if h : φ ∈ P.1 then
    ord M hDVR P (Polynomial.aeval φ (minpoly ℚ (P.residue ⟨φ, h⟩)))
  else -ord M hDVR P φ

/-- A true Belyi condition on all valuative places, not an affine derivative
surrogate. The residue-finite proof is separately exposed in the consumer. -/
def IsBelyi (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M) (φ : M.K) : Prop :=
  Transcendental ℚ φ ∧
    ∀ P : Place M.K, 1 < ramIdx M hDVR φ P → P ∈ cusps M hDVR φ

/-- Genuine divisors on all proper valuative places. -/
abbrev Divisor (M : Model N) : Type := Place M.K →₀ ℤ

noncomputable def divisorDegree (M : Model N) (D : Divisor M) : ℤ :=
  D.sum fun P n => n * (P.degree : ℤ)

/-- The reduced cusp divisor, parameterized only by a proof of its actual
finite support. No height function or divisor coefficient is freely supplied. -/
noncomputable def cuspDivisor (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M) (φ : M.K)
    (hfin : (cusps M hDVR φ).Finite) : Divisor M :=
  ∑ P ∈ hfin.toFinset, Finsupp.single P 1

/-- The canonical degree of the smooth degree-N plane Fermat curve. Its
identification with the valuative canonical divisor is a later explicit node. -/
def planeCanonicalDegree (N : ℕ) : ℤ := (N : ℤ) * ((N : ℤ) - 3)

/-- The strict quantitative condition needed by the height-comparison child.
This records the actual degree of the reduced cusp divisor. No equality at
the degree ratio is accepted. -/
def StrictQ (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M) (φ : M.K)
    (hfin : (cusps M hDVR φ).Finite) (q : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (divisorDegree M (cuspDivisor M hDVR φ hfin) : ℝ) /
    (planeCanonicalDegree N : ℝ) < q

/-- The affine open corresponding to the already fixed point carrier. -/
def AffinePoint (M : Model N) : Type :=
  {x : QbarPoint M.K // ∃ (hu : M.u ∈ x.P.1) (hv : M.v ∈ x.P.1),
    x.eval M.u hu ≠ 0 ∧ x.eval M.v hv ≠ 0}

/-- Exact identity of the affine valuative model with the existing Fermat
algebraic pairs, including the actual point field. Its existence is open. -/
structure AffineIdentification (M : Model N) where
  equiv : AffinePoint M ≃ AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Pt N
  eval_u : ∀ x : AffinePoint M, ∀ hu : M.u ∈ x.1.P.1,
    (equiv x).1.1 = x.1.eval M.u hu
  eval_v : ∀ x : AffinePoint M, ∀ hv : M.v ∈ x.1.P.1,
    (equiv x).1.2 = x.1.eval M.v hv
  field_eq : ∀ x : AffinePoint M,
    x.1.fieldOf = AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.fieldOf (equiv x)

/-- Source-faithful noncritical Belyi selection on the concrete Fermat field.
This says that arbitrary finite sets of proper places avoid the cusps. -/
def NoncriticalSelection (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M) : Prop :=
  ∀ T : Finset (Place M.K), ∃ φ : M.K,
    IsBelyi M hDVR φ ∧ ∀ P ∈ T, P ∉ cusps M hDVR φ

/-- The exact next geometric input. Every existential component has a
separate open theorem below; no assertion is installed in Definitions. -/
def NoncriticalInput (N : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ M : Model N, ∃ hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M,
    ResiduesFinite M ∧ Nonempty (AffineIdentification M) ∧
      NoncriticalSelection M hDVR ∧
      (∀ φ : M.K, IsBelyi M hDVR φ → (cusps M hDVR φ).Finite)

end AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper

Shinichi Mochizuki, Noncritical Belyi Maps, Theorem 2.5 and Corollary 3.2, pp.5–8; https://www.kurims.kyoto-u.ac.jp/~motizuki/Noncritical%20Belyi%20Maps.pdf . No Iut/Genl/Heights/Belyi runtime import is used. Actual source carriers: Belyi/CurveField/Basic.lean:36,67; Place.lean:184,283,289; Residue.lean:37,76; Point.lean:38; NoncriticalBasic.lean:88–97; NoncriticalBridge.lean:47–54. The full Fermat presentation and its exact N degree over Q(u) are a new explicit specialization; irreducibility and existence remain Open.

nodes.explanation:
> Theorem 2.5. (Belyi Maps Noncritical at Prescribed Points) Let X be a smooth, proper, connected curve over \overline{\mathbb{Q}} and S,T \subseteq X(\overline{\mathbb{Q}}) finite sets of \overline{\mathbb{Q}}-rational points such that S \cap T = \emptyset. Then there exists a morphism \phi : X \to \mathbb{P}^{1}_{\overline{\mathbb{Q}}} such that: (a) \phi is unramified over \mathbb{P}^{1}_{\overline{\mathbb{Q}}}\backslash\{0,1,\infty\}; (b) \phi(S) \subseteq \{0,1,\infty\}; (c) we have \phi(T) \cap \{0,1,\infty\} = \emptyset. Moreover, if X, S, and T are defined over a number field F, then \phi may be taken to be defined over F.

— Shinichi Mochizuki, *Noncritical Belyi Maps*, Theorem 2.5, printed pp. 5–6.

**English**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.noncriticalRamificationFinite`

Let N be any natural number and M a given Model(N). This does not assert that such a model exists for every N. Its field K=M.K is an intermediate field over ℚ in an algebraic closure of ℚ(X). It has specified elements u,v with u transcendental over ℚ, u^N+v^N=1, and ℚ(u,v)=K. The extension K/ℚ(u) is finite-dimensional with dimension N. A place P of K is an actual valuation subring O_P⊊K containing every rational number. The carrier includes every such subring; it selects no affine chart. Membership f∈O_P is the source meaning of f being regular at P. A pole here means f∉O_P. The derivative D_ψ is the actual function CurveDeriv.derivAlong(ψ), not an arbitrary supplied derivation. For a characteristic-zero field K and ψ∈K, this function tests whether ψ is transcendental over ℚ and K is algebraic over ℚ(ψ). If both hold, it takes the formal polynomial derivative on ℚ[ψ] and extends it to K through the canonical Kähler differential equivalence for the formally étale extension ℚ[ψ]→K. If the conjunction fails, D_ψ is the zero derivation. Assume hDVR: every place ring O_P is a discrete valuation ring. Write o_P(f) for the exact order ord(M,hDVR,P,f) in the source. It is −WithZero.log(v_P(f)), where v_P is the valuation attached to the maximal ideal of that discrete valuation ring. The integer e_ψ(P)=ramIdx(M,hDVR,ψ,P) is defined by two cases. If ψ∈O_P, take the residue ψ̄ in the residue field of O_P and set e_ψ(P)=o_P(minpoly_ℚ(ψ̄)(ψ)). If ψ∉O_P, set e_ψ(P)=−o_P(ψ). The minimal polynomial is evaluated at the actual field element ψ. No ramification law is an extra parameter. Let ψ∈K be transcendental over ℚ. Then the set of all places P of K with 1<e_ψ(P) is finite, where e_ψ(P) is the actual integer index defined above. The quantifier includes every place, with no restriction to an affine chart or to places where ψ is regular. The written proof puts this set inside the union of two finite sets: the pole set {P:ψ∉O_P}, and the derivative-failure set {P:ψ∈O_P and there exists s∈O_P with D_ψ(s)∉O_P}. At a place in the first case, pole finiteness applies. At a place in the second case, the local derivative-obstruction child supplies the witness s. The existing curve-field theorem gives pole finiteness from Model; the other finite set is exactly the finite-failure child. The parent has a written combination proof, but that proof depends on both open sorry children. No complete proof of finite ramification is claimed by this source package.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.noncriticalRamificationFinite`

设 N 为任意自然数，M 为给定的 Model(N)。这里不声称每个 N 都存在这样的模型。其域 K=M.K 是有理函数域 ℚ(X) 的某个代数闭包中包含有理数域的中间域。模型指定元素 u,v，满足 u 在有理数域上超越、u^N+v^N=1、ℚ(u,v)=K；扩张 K/ℚ(u) 有限维且维数为 N。K 的一个处 P 是实际的赋值子环 O_P，满足 O_P≠K，并包含全部有理数。处的类型遍历所有这样的子环，不选择仿射图。f∈O_P 就是源代码中 f 在 P 处正则的含义；这里的极点指 f∉O_P。导子 D_ψ 是实际定义的函数 CurveDeriv.derivAlong(ψ)，不是任意另给的导子。对特征为零的域 K 及 ψ∈K，该定义检验两个条件：ψ 在有理数域上超越，且 K 在 ℚ(ψ) 上为代数扩张。两个条件都成立时，取 ℚ[ψ] 上的形式多项式求导，并通过形式平展扩张 ℚ[ψ]→K 的标准 Kähler 微分等价将其延拓到 K。若该合取不成立，则 D_ψ 是零导子。假设 hDVR：每个处的局部环 O_P 都是离散赋值环。记 o_P(f) 为源代码中确切定义的阶 ord(M,hDVR,P,f)。它等于 −WithZero.log(v_P(f))，其中 v_P 是该离散赋值环的极大理想所给出的赋值。整数 e_ψ(P)=ramIdx(M,hDVR,ψ,P) 分两种情况定义。若 ψ∈O_P，取 ψ 在 O_P 的剩余域中的像 ψ̄，令 e_ψ(P)=o_P(minpoly_ℚ(ψ̄)(ψ))。若 ψ∉O_P，令 e_ψ(P)=−o_P(ψ)。最小多项式在实际的域元素 ψ 处求值。分歧规律不是额外传入的参数。设 ψ∈K 在有理数域上超越。则满足 1<e_ψ(P) 的 K 的全部处 P 所成的集合是有限集，其中 e_ψ(P) 是上面实际定义的整数指数。量词包括所有处，不局限于某个仿射图，也不局限于 ψ 正则的处。给出的证明把该集合包含在两个有限集的并集中：极点集合 {P:ψ∉O_P}，以及导子失效集合 {P:ψ∈O_P，且存在 s∈O_P 使 D_ψ(s)∉O_P}。在第一种情况下使用极点有限性；在第二种情况下由局部导子障碍子定理给出见证元素 s。已有的曲线函数域定理由 Model 得到极点有限性；另一个有限集正是导子失效处有限性子定理的结论。父定理有写出的组合证明，但该证明依赖两个尚由 sorry 占位的子定理。此源文件包尚未给出分歧处有限性的完整证明。

> Theorem 2.5. (Belyi Maps Noncritical at Prescribed Points) Let X be a smooth, proper, connected curve over \overline{\mathbb{Q}} and S,T \subseteq X(\overline{\mathbb{Q}}) finite sets of \overline{\mathbb{Q}}-rational points such that S \cap T = \emptyset. Then there exists a morphism \phi : X \to \mathbb{P}^{1}_{\overline{\mathbb{Q}}} such that: (a) \phi is unramified over \mathbb{P}^{1}_{\overline{\mathbb{Q}}}\backslash\{0,1,\infty\}; (b) \phi(S) \subseteq \{0,1,\infty\}; (c) we have \phi(T) \cap \{0,1,\infty\} = \emptyset. Moreover, if X, S, and T are defined over a number field F, then \phi may be taken to be defined over F.

— Shinichi Mochizuki, *Noncritical Belyi Maps*, Theorem 2.5, printed pp. 5–6.

对任意自然数 N 及给定的次数为 N 的模型 M，取其实际域 K。该模型是介于 ℚ 与 ℚ(T) 的代数闭包之间的中间域，含有 u,v∈K，满足 u 在 ℚ 上超越、u^N+v^N=1、ℚ(u,v)=K，且 K/ℚ(u) 为次数 N 的有限扩张。采用离散性假设：K 的每个处的赋值环均为离散赋值环。对任意在 ℚ 上超越的 ψ∈K，以及满足 ψ∈O_P 的任意处 P，令 m 为完整剩余域 κ(P) 中 res_P(ψ) 在 ℚ 上的最小多项式，实际整数分歧指数定义为 e_P(ψ)=ord_P(m(ψ))。若 1<e_P(ψ)，则存在 s∈O_P，使 D_ψ(s)∉O_P。因此满足 D_ψ(ψ)=1 的实际规范化导子不保持该局部环。结论是存在局部环外的导数，不是任意给定指数或导子的性质，也不声称每个 s 的导数都离开该环。不在这里断言模型存在，也不对 N 另加数值条件。

> Theorem 2.5. (Belyi Maps Noncritical at Prescribed Points) Let X be a smooth, proper, connected curve over \overline{\mathbb{Q}} and S,T \subseteq X(\overline{\mathbb{Q}}) finite sets of \overline{\mathbb{Q}}-rational points such that S \cap T = \emptyset. Then there exists a morphism \phi : X \to \mathbb{P}^{1}_{\overline{\mathbb{Q}}} such that: (a) \phi is unramified over \mathbb{P}^{1}_{\overline{\mathbb{Q}}}\backslash\{0,1,\infty\}; (b) \phi(S) \subseteq \{0,1,\infty\}; (c) we have \phi(T) \cap \{0,1,\infty\} = \emptyset. Moreover, if X, S, and T are defined over a number field F, then \phi may be taken to be defined over F.

— Shinichi Mochizuki, *Noncritical Belyi Maps*, Theorem 2.5, printed pp. 5–6.

> Theorem 2.5. (Belyi Maps Noncritical at Prescribed Points) Let X be a smooth, proper, connected curve over \overline{\mathbb{Q}} and S,T \subseteq X(\overline{\mathbb{Q}}) finite sets of \overline{\mathbb{Q}}-rational points such that S \cap T = \emptyset. Then there exists a morphism \phi : X \to \mathbb{P}^{1}_{\overline{\mathbb{Q}}} such that: (a) \phi is unramified over \mathbb{P}^{1}_{\overline{\mathbb{Q}}}\backslash\{0,1,\infty\}; (b) \phi(S) \subseteq \{0,1,\infty\}; (c) we have \phi(T) \cap \{0,1,\infty\} = \emptyset. Moreover, if X, S, and T are defined over a number field F, then \phi may be taken to be defined over F.
